    total = 0
    sig = 0
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            parts = line.split('\t')
            if len(parts) < 6:
                continue
            total += 1
            try:
                baseMean = float(parts[1])
                log2FC = float(parts[2])
                padj = float(parts[5])

                continue
            
            # Apply criteria: padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10
            if padj < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) > 1 and baseMean > 10:
                sig += 1
    
    print(f"{label}:")
    print(f"  Total genes: {total}")
    print(f"  padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10: {sig}")

    up = 0
    down = 0
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            parts = line.split('\t')
            if len(parts) < 6:
                continue
            try:
                baseMean = float(parts[1])
                log2FC = float(parts[2])
                padj = float(parts[5])
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                continue
            if padj < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) > 1 and baseMean > 10:
                if log2FC > 0:
                    up += 1
                else:
                    down += 1
    
    print(f"  Upregulated (KL > WL): {up}")
    print(f"  Downregulated (KL < WL): {down}")
